source: Measured on kleod's build (klonoa is tuning data): kleod.map places SoundMainRAM at 0x0804f318 in asm/m4a0.o(.text), linked at its ROM address, and the next symbol, SoundMainBTM, at 0x0804f6bc, so the range is [0x0804F318, 0x0804F6BC), 0x3A4 bytes (arm-none-eabi-nm -n kleod.elf gives the same two addresses); its entry is Thumb (asm/m4a0.s: thumb_func_start SoundMainRAM, then ARM from sub_0804F324). kleod.map places SoundMainRAM_Buffer at 0x03000388, which m4aSoundInit's CpuCopy32 (src/m4a.c line 81) fills from SoundMainRAM & ~1 (its pool words 0x0804F319 and 0x03000388 at 0x0804FF98 and 0x0804FF9C), and SoundMain enters it there (ldr r3, =0x03000389; bx r3 at 0x0804F2FC). The copy is sizeof(SoundMainRAM_Buffer) = 0x400 bytes, which also takes SoundMainBTM and the start of the routines after it, but those run from the ROM (SoundMainBTM is called through MPlayJumpTable at its ROM address), so only the bytes up to SoundMainBTM run from RAM.
